rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: EventWhisper is an MCP server by Maurice Fielenbach that provides AI assistants with access to Windows Event Log (.evtx) files through Python's evtx library and fastmcp framework. The implementation offers tools for discovering EVTX files in directories, querying events with filters for time ranges, event IDs, and text content, and projecting specific fields from event data. Built with comprehensive normalization utilities for handling various input formats and robust error handling, it enables AI systems to analyze Windows system logs for security investigations, troubleshooting system issues, and forensic analysis workflows.
